A '''drop company''' was a formation within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Drop companies were essentially [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Line company|line companies]] with an expanded support element. A drop company would be [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]-loaded for deployment for missions of up to six [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], although standard doctrine called for the missions to last only two weeks. Support personnel were trained in hostile environment survival and they were expected to train the individual [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] how to survive.<ref name="ISB" />

A drop company would be augmented by the addition of two more [[line platoon]]s, an [[assault platoon]], and an [[armor platoon]].<ref name="ISB2" />
